name: Case study body (platform)
purpose: Tells one platform customer story end to end: who the customer is, the headline result, the key numbers, the narrative, a customer quote and a closing demo call to action.
description: One long section that is the whole case-study-platform template body: an opening block (customer logo top-left, serif H1 bottom-left over a radial-masked hero image, play-video ring icon on the right), a row of 4 info cards (4 columns, 1 column at tablet and below: two stat cards, a challenge-tag card and an integrations-chip card, the last stat card carrying a "See how" anchor link), then a two-column body with a sticky left TOC (section titles + Testimonial entry, scroll-spy highlight, sidebar demo card; the sidebar is hidden at 479 and below) beside the article (H2 + rich paragraphs per section, optional inline image), a testimonial card, a serif video heading with a video placeholder and caption, and finally a centred serif CTA heading with a button. Because it carries the page H1, the template has no separate hero section.

evidenceNotes: Per-route copy is generated by prose()/phrase() in src/pages/content/caseStudyPlatformData.js; the sample was evaluated with node from that file. Labels not set per route (tocLabel, testimonialLabel, sidebarCta, cta) come from the component DEFAULTS.
Route paragraphs carry no inline links; only the component DEFAULTS use [[link]] markers (up to 4 in one paragraph), so the rich budget follows the defaults.
Section `image` is a boolean in code (renders Placeholder "Inline image"); modelled as an optional media slot.
/case-study/customer-3 passes logoSizeClassName for a tall square logo (layout knob, not modelled).
CLONE_SPEC_PAGES.md §E lists a CSS `icon-anim-anim` 3s icon bob on cs-platform-body; the clone code has no such animation (the play icon is static).
